motivation.observation: On the fresh 144-world live-support overlap block, rootedstock_net12v3 had 0/24 fully equivalent pairs, 12/24 demonstrably non-equivalent pairs, and 12/24 inconclusive pairs under the preregistered direct-equivalence audit. Demonstrable failures concentrated in future net transport pressure (8 pairs) and rooted membership stock (4 pairs).
diagnostic_only_clues: Net-transport-failing pairs had larger anchor mismatches in social exposure and recruitment hazard than pairs without a net-transport failure.
Net transport is a signed first-moment flux; equal net flux can conceal different gross incoming/outgoing transport throughput.
motivation.guard: These clues nominate a finite candidate screen only. They receive no confirmatory evidentiary credit from the already-inspected block.

analysis.method: Use the direct paired-branch bootstrap equivalence audit and the exact inherited practical margins/domain scale floors from closure_equivalence_audit_contract_v1.json.
analysis.ranking_tertiary: lower state dimension, then lower maximum match distance
analysis.eligibility: 24 live pairs, at least 6 per activity stratum, maximum selected match distance <=1.25
analysis.no_rescue_rule: The 16-branch screen cannot certify strategic closure even if a candidate passes nominal equivalence thresholds.

confirmation_rule.nomination: Nominate at most one minimal candidate. It must have zero demonstrably non-equivalent pairs in the screen; otherwise no candidate is nominated and the local-scalar closure architecture is reconsidered before any further additions.
confirmation_rule.required_gate: Apply the original direct-equivalence gate: >=0.90 equivalent overall, >=0.80 equivalent in every stratum, <=0.10 demonstrably non-equivalent overall, all anchors live, maximum match distance <=1.25.
confirmation_rule.failure_interpretation: If no one-coordinate candidate is screen-eligible with zero demonstrable failures, stop scalar-coordinate accretion. Test whether the missing state is intrinsically spatial (a transport/reproduction field or higher moment) rather than another local scalar.

policy_guard: Government strategy ranking remains blocked throughout this screen. Only a separate fresh confirmation PASS can restore the synthetic decision-support certificate.
